svg.title: What Rohith does
svg.desc: Proofs of concept: 150+. Discovery, solution design, and a working deployment with Sales and GTM Enterprise deployments: 50+. SSO, migrations, and go-live through GitOps clusters and BYOC installs Storage & query performance: <30s. TB-scale scans after sort keys, projections, codecs, and compaction Petabyte scale on Kubernetes: 2+ PB. ClickHouse, Druid, and DuckDB on GKE with Helm, Terraform, and Go operators Roadmap and ownership: 50+. Customer requirements turned into shipped features, and accounts owned Agents that ship faster: MCP. MCP servers, agent skills, and an AI on-call agent for every deployment
